description: This file implements a priority-based write scheduler for HTTP/2 streams, following RFC 9218, including stream management, prioritization, and frame handling.

classes.name: streamMetadata
classes.description: Holds metadata for a stream, including its location in the write queue and its priority parameters.

classes.name: priorityWriteSchedulerRFC9218
classes.description: Implements a priority-based write scheduler for HTTP/2 streams, managing control frames, stream queues, and prioritization logic.

methods.name: newPriorityWriteSchedulerRFC9218
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new instance of the priority write scheduler.

methods.name: OpenStream
methods.description: Opens a new stream with specified options, adding it to the scheduler and placing it in the appropriate priority queue.

methods.name: CloseStream
methods.description: Closes a stream, removing it from the scheduler and freeing associated resources.

methods.name: AdjustStream
methods.description: Adjusts the priority of an existing stream, repositioning it within the scheduler's queues.

methods.name: Push
methods.description: Adds a frame write request to the scheduler, handling control frames separately.

methods.name: Pop
methods.description: Retrieves the next frame write request based on priority, handling control frames first and then stream data.
